gaps.sentence: She has decided to cycle to work ___ taking the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' = in place of the bus journey.

gaps.sentence: The ferry was cancelled; ___, we drove the long way round.
gaps.explanation: 'Consequently' introduces the consequence of the cancellation.

gaps.sentence: ___ you finish early, come and give us a hand.
gaps.explanation: 'If' introduces a real condition; 'in case' would change the meaning to precaution.

gaps.sentence: I will send the report today ___ you asked for it early.
The essay was submitted late and, ___, it ignored the brief entirely.
gaps.explanation: 'What is more' adds a further, stronger point to an already negative picture.

gaps.sentence: He went back inside, ___ the danger.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite the danger' — noun phrase; although needs a clause.

gaps.sentence: ___ the criticism, the festival has been renewed for three more years.
gaps.explanation: 'In spite of' + noun phrase concedes the criticism.

gaps.sentence: ___ the price, the location is absolutely perfect.
gaps.explanation: 'Apart from the price' = the only negative in an otherwise positive description.
